'''Uri-Los''' was an [[A'Mar]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers of [[Lamus]]. He was not eligible to participate in [[the Vigil]] as he had already drunk the waters from the [[Wellspring (Lamus)|Wellspring]]. He took part in the [[Beastlord's Hunt]] when his party was attacked by a [[Brachian Beastlord]]. His companion [[Jeg]] was poisoned by the beast and together they went to the Wellspring to seek help from the offworlders protecting it at that time.
